rules.title: he/she + -es: watches, fixes, goes
rules.short_explanation: After verbs ending in s, sh, ch, x, z or o, add es for he, she or it. Examples: watches, washes, fixes, goes and does.
rules.tts_text: After s, sh, ch, x, z or o, add e s.
rules.mnemonic: Sassy sounds need es: watch becomes watches.

examples.text: She watches the news every evening.
examples.note: Watch ends in ch, so add es.

examples.text: He washes the van on Saturdays.
examples.note: Wash ends in sh, so add es.

examples.text: The technician fixes the machines.
examples.note: Fix ends in x, so add es.

examples.text: She goes to the warehouse by bus.
examples.note: Go ends in o, so add es.

examples.text: He does the inventory every month.
examples.note: Do ends in o, so add es.

examples.note: Pass ends in s, so add es.

examples.text: She finishes work at six o'clock.
examples.note: Finish ends in sh, so add es.

examples.text: He catches the early train.
examples.note: Catch ends in ch, so add es.

examples.text: The teacher teaches English online.
examples.note: Teach ends in ch, so add es.

examples.text: She pushes the trolley to the shelf.
examples.note: Push ends in sh, so add es.

examples.text: The phone buzzes when a message arrives.
examples.note: Buzz ends in z, so add es.

rules.title: consonant + y → ies: studies, flies; vowel + y → ys: plays
rules.short_explanation: For he, she or it, change y to ies after a consonant: study becomes studies and fly becomes flies. After a vowel plus y, simply add s: play becomes plays and enjoy becomes enjoys.
rules.tts_text: Consonant plus y becomes i e s; vowel plus y adds s.
rules.mnemonic: Consonant y? Change y to ies.

examples.text: She studies logistics at university.
examples.note: Study ends in consonant plus y, so use ies.

examples.text: The plane flies to Prague every day.
He carries the parcels to the van.
She tries to finish the report today.
He hurries to catch the morning bus.
She worries about the delayed shipment.
The office copies the documents twice.
He replies to customer emails quickly.
The baby cries when she is hungry.
She plays tennis after work.
examples.note: Play ends in vowel plus y, so add s.

examples.note: Enjoy ends in vowel plus y, so add s.
